nodes.description: uint256 public cost = 0.075 ether, price required to mint.
uint256 public maxSupply = 3333, hard cap on total tokens.
uint256 public headStart = block.timestamp + 45 days, timestamp derived state.
bool public paused, disables minting.
bool public revealed, controls which URI tokenURI returns.
string public notRevealedUri returned before reveal.
string baseURI used to build token metadata URI.
string public baseExtension = '.json' appended to token URI.
address payable commissions, hardcoded ETH receiver.
msg.sender, caller controlled address used as minter, gift seed and withdrawal recipient.
block.timestamp, miner influenceable value used as randomness seed and in headStart.
mint() payable: mints supply+1, picks a random gift recipient and forwards ETH via low-level calls.
withdraw() payable onlyOwner: sends entire contract balance to msg.sender via low-level call.
randomNum(_mod,_seed,_salt): pseudo-random from keccak256(block.timestamp, msg.sender, seed, salt) % _mod.
reveal() onlyOwner: sets revealed = true.
setCost(_newCost) onlyOwner: updates cost.
setNotRevealedURI(_notRevealedURI) onlyOwner: updates notRevealedUri.
setBaseURI(_newBaseURI) onlyOwner: updates baseURI.
setBaseExtension(_newBaseExtension) onlyOwner: updates baseExtension.
pause(_state) onlyOwner: toggles paused flag.
tokenURI(tokenId): returns notRevealedUri or composed base URI + id + extension.
walletOfOwner(_owner) view: enumerates token ids owned by an address.
_baseURI() internal: returns baseURI state variable.
constructor(_initBaseURI,_initNotRevealedUri): initializes ERC721 and calls setBaseURI/setNotRevealedURI.
Low-level payable call forwarding 80% of msg.value to commissions after minting.
Low-level payable call sending giftValue to a randomly selected token owner (attacker influenceable).
Low-level payable call in withdraw sending full balance to msg.sender with no state guard.
Pseudo randomness derived from block.timestamp and msg.sender, predictable/manipulable on-chain.
_mod parameter of randomNum, modulus of the pseudo-random result.
_seed parameter of randomNum, part of the hash input.
_salt parameter of randomNum, part of the hash input.
tokenId parameter of tokenURI.
_owner parameter of walletOfOwner.
_newCost parameter of setCost.
_notRevealedURI parameter of setNotRevealedURI.
_newBaseURI parameter of setBaseURI.
_newBaseExtension parameter of setBaseExtension.
_state parameter of pause.
uint256 supply = totalSupply() captured at the start of mint.
address payable giftAddress, recipient of the gift payout computed from randomNum.
uint256 giftValue, payout amount (10% of msg.value or 50% of balance on final mint).

edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller/minter and the receiver of the newly minted token.
withdraw transfers the full contract balance to msg.sender.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random seed inside randomNum.
block.timestamp is used as the randomness seed, allowing miner/validator manipulation.
mint passes block.timestamp as _seed into randomNum to select the gift recipient.
headStart state variable is initialized from block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
mint reads maxSupply to enforce the supply cap.
mint reads the paused flag before minting.
mint reads cost to validate msg.value.
mint performs an external low-level value call to commissions after state changes.
mint performs an external low-level value call to a caller-influenced gift recipient.
mint calls randomNum to pick the gift recipient.
randomNum derives its output from keccak256(block.timestamp, msg.sender, ...), i.e. weak on-chain randomness.
withdraw performs an external low-level value call to msg.sender with no reentrancy guard.
the recipient of the withdraw low-level call is msg.sender.
a contract gift recipient can re-enter mint/fallback while the ETH transfer is in progress.
a contract msg.sender can re-enter withdraw from its receive hook before the call returns.
setCost (onlyOwner) writes the cost state variable.
setNotRevealedURI (onlyOwner) writes notRevealedUri.
setBaseURI (onlyOwner) writes baseURI.
setBaseExtension (onlyOwner) writes baseExtension.
pause (onlyOwner) writes the paused flag.
reveal (onlyOwner) sets revealed to true.
constructor calls setBaseURI to initialize the base URI.
constructor calls setNotRevealedURI to initialize the hidden URI.
tokenURI reads the revealed flag to decide which URI to return.
tokenURI returns notRevealedUri while the collection is unrevealed.
_baseURI returns the baseURI state variable.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to build the metadata path.
tokenURI appends baseExtension when composing the token URI.
_mod parameter feeds the modulo inside randomNum.
_seed parameter is hashed inside randomNum.
_salt parameter is hashed inside randomNum.
tokenId parameter is used to build the token URI.
_owner parameter is enumerated in walletOfOwner.
_newCost parameter is written to cost in setCost.
_notRevealedURI parameter is written to notRevealedUri.
_newBaseURI parameter is written to baseURI.
_newBaseExtension parameter is written to baseExtension.
_state parameter is written to the paused flag.
local supply is read from totalSupply() at the start of mint.
local supply is compared against maxSupply in the mint cap check.
local giftAddress is the recipient of the gift low-level value call.
local giftValue is the amount forwarded in the gift low-level value call.

normalization_plan.reason: _mod is only used to bound the pseudo-random result inside randomNum.
_seed is only used as a hash input inside randomNum.
_salt is only used as a hash input inside randomNum.
tokenId is only consumed by tokenURI to build the metadata string.
_owner is only consumed by the view enumeration function walletOfOwner.
_newCost is only assigned to cost inside the owner-only setCost.
_notRevealedURI is only assigned to notRevealedUri in its owner-only setter.
_newBaseURI is only assigned to baseURI in its owner-only setter.
_newBaseExtension is only assigned to baseExtension in its owner-only setter.
_state is only assigned to the paused flag inside pause.
supply is a transient local snapshot of totalSupply used for the cap and gift logic in mint.
giftAddress directly becomes the recipient of the external gift value call.
giftValue directly becomes the amount sent in the external gift value call.
